description: This file defines the class 'hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint' which models a WiFi endpoint in a TR-069 device management context. It includes member variables, methods for getting and setting WiFi endpoint properties, and documentation comments. It also declares external dependencies and is part of the TR-069 WiFi object model.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_EndPoint
classes.description: Represents a WiFi endpoint with properties such as Enable, Status, Alias, ProfileReference, SSIDReference, and statistics. Provides methods to get/set properties and manage instances.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Enable
methods.description: Checks whether the WiFi endpoint is enabled.

methods.name: set_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Alias
methods.description: Gets the alias name of the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: set_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Alias
methods.description: Sets the alias name of the WiFi endpoint.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_ProfileNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Gets the number of profile entries.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Stats_LastDataDownlinkRate
methods.description: Retrieves the last data downlink rate.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Stats_LastDataUplinkRate
methods.description: Retrieves the last data uplink rate.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_EndPoint_Stats_SignalStrength
methods.description: Gets the signal strength in dBm.
